text.2:17: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see,
text.6:104: Proofs have come unto you from your Lord, so whoso seeth, it is for his own good, and whoso is blind is blind to his own hurt. And I am not a keeper over you.
text.7:179: Already have We urged unto hell many of the jinn and humankind, having hearts wherewith they understand not, and having eyes wherewith they see not, and having ears wherewith they hear not. These are as the cattle - nay, but they are worse! These are the neglectful.
text.7:195: Have they feet wherewith they walk, or have they hands wherewith they hold, or have they eyes wherewith they see, or have they ears wherewith they hear? Say: Call upon your (so-called) partners (of Allah), and then contrive against me, spare me not!
text.7:198: And if ye (Muslims) call them to the guidance they hear not; and thou (Muhammad) seest them looking toward thee, but they see not.
text.10:43: And of them is he who looketh toward thee. But canst thou guide the blind even though they see not?
text.11:20: Such will not escape in the earth, nor have they any protecting friends beside Allah. For them the torment will be double. They could not bear to hear, and they used not to see.
text.18:26: Say: Allah is Best Aware how long they tarried. His is the Invisible of the heavens and the earth. How clear of sight is He and keen of hearing! They have no protecting friend beside Him, and He maketh none to share in His government.
text.19:38: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.
text.19:42: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?
text.21:3: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?
text.27:54: And Lot! when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination knowingly?
text.28:72: Say: Have ye thought, if Allah made day everlasting for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is a god beside Allah who could bring you night wherein ye rest? Will ye not then see?
text.32:12: Couldst thou but see when the guilty hang their heads before their Lord, (and say): Our Lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back; we will do right, now we are sure.
text.32:27: Have they not seen how We lead the water to the barren land and therewith bring forth crops whereof their cattle eat, and they themselves? Will they not then see?
text.36:9: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.
text.36:66: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?
text.37:175: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
text.37:179: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
text.43:51: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?
text.51:21: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
text.52:15: Is this magic, or do ye not see?
text.56:85: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
text.68:5: And thou wilt see and they will see
text.69:38: But nay! I swear by all that ye see
text.69:39: And all that ye see not
